regulations.title: Medical electrical equipment - Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance
Medical electrical equipment - European harmonized standard

requirements.description: A list of ACCESSORIES, detachable parts, and materials for use with ME EQUIPMENT provided
Other equipment providing power to ME SYSTEM sufficiently described (e.g. part number, RATED VOLTAGE, max or min power, protection class, intermittent or continuous duty)
Disposal of waste products, residues, etc., and of ME EQUIPMENT and ACCESSORIES at the end of their EXPECTED SERVICE LIFE are identified in the instruction for use
requirements.result_remark: Refer to 'Maintenance' part of the Operation guide

requirements.description: Instructions for use include information specified in 7.9.3 or identify where it can be found (e.g. in a service manual)
Instruction for use for ME EQUIPMENT emitting radiation for medical purposes indicates the nature, type, intensity and distribution of this radiation
The instructions for use for ME EQUIPMENT or ACCESSORIES supplied sterile indicate that they have been sterilized and the method of sterilization
The instructions for use indicate the necessary instructions in the event of damage to the sterile packaging, and where appropriate, details of the appropriate methods of re-sterilization
The instructions for use contain a unique version identifier
Technical description
All essential data provided for safe operation, transport, storage, and measures or conditions necessary for installing ME EQUIPMENT, and preparing it for use
Permissible environmental conditions of use including conditions for transport
requirements.result_remark: Refer to 'Product specifications' of Operation guide

requirements.description: All characteristics of ME EQUIPMENT including range(s), accuracy
requirements.result_remark: Refer to 'Product specifications' of Operation guide

requirements.description: Special installation requirements such as maximum permissible apparent impedance of SUPPLY MAINS
Permissible range of values of inlet pressure and flow, and chemical composition of cooling liquid used for cooling
A description of means of isolating ME EQUIPMENT from SUPPLY MAINS, when such means not in ME EQUIPMENT
A description of means for checking oil level
A warning statement addressing HAZARDS that can result from unauthorized modification
requirements.result_remark: Refer to 'Maintenance' section of the Operation guide

requirements.description: WARNING: No modification of this equipment is allowed
WARNING: Do not modify this equipment without authorization of the manufacturer
WARNING: If this equipment is modified, appropriate inspection and testing must be conducted to ensure continued safe use of equipment
Information pertaining to ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE and any necessary recurrent ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE and BASIC SAFETY testing including details of the means, methods and recommended frequency
requirements.result_remark: Refer to 'ELECTROMAGNETIC COMPATIBILITY INFORMATION' of Operation guide

requirements.description: Technical description separable from instructions for use contains required information - information as in clause 7.2
requirements.result_remark: Technical description merged with operation guide

requirements.description: Technical description - all applicable classifications in Clause 6, warning and safety notices, and explanation of SAFETY SIGNS marked on ME EQUIPMENT
Technical description - a brief description of the ME EQUIPMENT, how the ME EQUIPMENT functions and its significant physical and performance characteristics
Technical description - a unique version identifier
MANUFACTURER'S optional requirements for minimum qualifications of operators
The technical description contains the following required information

semantic_fragments.content: Parts requiring preventive inspection and maintenance to be performed by SERVICE PERSONNEL identified including periods of application - Verdict: N/A. Instructions provided to ensure adequate maintenance of ME EQUIPMENT containing rechargeable batteries to be maintained by anyone other than SERVICE PERSONNEL - Verdict: N/A.

Warning statements required by IEC60601-1 clause 7.9.3.1 regarding unauthorized modification: (1) 'WARNING: No modification of this equipment is allowed'; (2) 'WARNING: Do not modify this equipment without authorization of the manufacturer'; (3) 'WARNING: If this equipment is modified, appropriate inspection and testing must be conducted to ensure continued safe use of equipment'. All three warnings are addressed in the 'Maintenance' section of the Operation guide and verified as Pass.
